title: Casa em X
description:
Casa em X is conceived from a hybrid residential programme, combining a primary T2 dwelling with an independent T0 unit, both integrated within a single built volume. This functional requirement informed a deliberately articulated architectural solution, where the plan responds directly to the coexistence of distinct uses.

The programme’s complexity is expressed through the building’s formal language, defined by precise volumetric cuts and expressive overhangs that shape the overall composition. Each volume is given its own identity through variations in colour, materiality and texture.

The T2 dwelling is organised over two levels, largely overlapping the independent T0 volume. Despite the functional autonomy of each unit, the project maintains a cohesive architectural reading, where volumetric overlap and articulation become central elements of the design language.
